# Rocket Q4 NVMe SSD

 

5 YEARS STANDARD WARRANTY

5-year warranty. No registration required.

View Warranty Policy →

 Sale price $299.99 Regular price $849.99 

 Free shipping 5-8 business days 

 Customer Support Mon-Fri 9:00 - 17:00 EST 

 

 Extended Warranty Up to 5 Years 

 Specs 

- PCIe 4.0 x4 interface, NVMe 1.3 compliant. APST/ASPM/L1.2 support.
- Supports SMART and TRIM functions. Works in an enclosure.
- Wide flash compatibility. Uses QLC with DRAM.
- Advanced endurance features for a long drive lifespan.
- Upgradeable firmware and software support.
- 4.0-capable motherboard and M.2 heatsink are recommended, but the drive is backward compatible with PCIe 3.0 and 2.0 M.2 sockets.

 Dimensions 

Length: 3.15 in. Width: 0.86 in. Height: 0.11 in. Weight: 0.2 oz.

 In the box 

- M.2 2280 PCIe 4.0 NVMe QLC SSD User manual

...

## FAQ

Is this drive compatible with my system?

You must have a motherboard with an available M.2 socket that supports a NVMe drive. It may be possible to use an enclosure or adapter, but NVMe boot support on older systems is not guaranteed. This drive is backward compatible with PCIe 3.0 and 2.0 even with fewer than four lanes, but will be bandwidth-limited.

What is the warranty for this drive?

1 year or 5 years with registration. Endurance is rated at 800TBW for the 4TB SKU.

What's the hardware on the SSD?

This drive utilizes Phison's E16 controller with DRAM, along with 96-layer or newer QLC.

...

Really fast folder transfers and reads, no lag. connected into my Gigabyte B550I with no issues.

Maude Wunsch 

For what it's rated at, it's a solid drive at a great price point, however...

Be aware that just because this is PCIe v4.0 it's not actually using that full capacity. Out of my three NVME's this is my slowest one. Plotting chia plots takes a good 2x longer on this drive than on my Samsung SSD 980 Pro. The drive is not faulty, it's just only rated at 4700/1800 read/write speeds. Had I been more aware of this I would have gotten another Samsung 980 Pro. But I can't fault the drive. Overall for normal usage the dollars-per-capacity is a great price point.

 Nishtha Dewan 

They're being modest

Advertised as 4.9GB/s Read and 3.5GB/s Write. This thing achieves almost 6GB/s read without cooling... just stop reading and add to cart.

...

Not really worth the increased cost

Seems to work fine. Tests at about 4500MB/sec but speed drops off very significantly with smaller and smaller files. In fact below about 1MB file size is almost the same speed as PCI-e 3 devices.In real world use with Windows File Explorer the device operates at about 20% faster speed than the Sabrent PCI-e 3 devices.Probably not really worth the increased cost.
